hooks.logic:
Let ability be the id of the move labelled "bad_breath" on the enemy.
Let ability2 be the id of the move labelled "purify" on the enemy.
If condition flag "ability_done" is up this frame, then
  Let lastAbility be the last move of the enemy.
  Let v2 be the value "abilityId" of lastAbility.
  If v2 is ability, then set the register's 'shouldUsePurify' to true.
  If v2 is ability2, then set the register's 'shouldUsePurify' to false.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let withoutAbilityList be the excluded moves of the enemy.
  If withoutAbilityList contains ability2, then set the register's 'shouldUsePurify' to false.
  If the register's 'shouldUsePurify', then the enemy uses the move labelled "purify".
  Otherwise, the enemy → lot-and-register-ability-without with (withoutAbilityList).
